title: Field configurations for field-free RF trap networks
summary: We develop a constructive framework for designing radio-frequency (RF) trap networks from planar data and show that non-smooth field-free guide lines are possible in such networks. Given analytic Cauchy data on a symmetry plane, namely the potential and its normal derivative, Laplace's equation determines a local three-dimensional continuation. The odd subclass of this harmonic extension maps an arbitrary analytic generating function $P(x,y)$ to a harmonic potential whose in-plane radio-frequency null set is exactly $P(x,y)=0$.
